description: Lehi-ward-style Relief Society personas. Used only by the generation CLI — never shown in the app.

personas.label: Young mother with small children
personas.notes: Little margin for extra homework; needs hope, one realistic step, and feeling seen—not guilt.

personas.label: Parent of teenagers
personas.notes: Negotiating influence vs. control; needs principles for tension at home and faith when kids pull away.

personas.label: Empty nester
personas.notes: Rethinking purpose and service; less survival mode, more meaning, marriage, and mentoring.

personas.label: Newer or returning member
personas.notes: Gentle vocabulary; safe to ask basic questions; avoid insider jargon and assumed history.

personas.label: Lifelong disciple who loves depth
personas.notes: Bored by plot summary; wants synthesis, scripture patterns, and ‘so what’ beyond the talk title.

personas.label: Quiet struggler or tired believer
personas.notes: Room for honesty and fatigue; questions must not feel like debate traps or testimony pressure.

personas.label: Scripture- and doctrine-oriented learner
personas.notes: Wants ties to Christ, covenants, and verses—not feelings-only prompts.

personas.label: Overwhelmed caregiver or stretched single adult
personas.notes: Capacity is thin; small, Christ-centered application; no pile-on commitments.
